Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class VfpTableLookup

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.VfpTableLookup
All Implemented Interfaces:
VlpProvider
public final class VfpTableLookup extends Object implements VlpProvider
Lift curve lookup in a METRIC VFPPROD table, read the way Eclipse and OPM Flow read it: multilinear interpolation in rate, outlet pressure, water ratio and gas ratio, with linear extrapolation outside the axes.

The table may use any of the rate types OIL, LIQ or GAS, water ratios WCT, WOR or WGR and gas ratios GOR, GLR or OGR. bottomHolePressure(double, double, double, double, double) takes coordinates on the table's own basis; onOilBasis() gives a provider on the oil rate, water cut and gas-oil ratio basis used by the hybrid production model. The same class serves well tubing tables (flowing bottom-hole pressure against wellhead pressure) and network branch tables (branch inlet pressure against outlet node pressure).

1.0

    • bottomHolePressure

      public double bottomHolePressure(double rate, double outletPressure, double waterRatio, double gasRatio, double alq)
      Calculates the flowing pressure at the table datum for one table coordinate.

      Coordinates are on the basis of the table itself.

      Specified by:
      bottomHolePressure in interface VlpProvider
      Parameters:
      rate - surface rate in Sm3/day of the table rate basis
      outletPressure - pressure at the outlet node (THP axis value) in bara
      waterRatio - water ratio in the unit of the selected water ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      gasRatio - gas ratio in the unit of the selected gas ratio type (0 when the table has no such axis)
      alq - artificial lift quantity (gas lift rate in Sm3/day, 0 when not used)
      Returns:
      flowing pressure at datum in bara; NaN or an exception marks the point as infeasible
